channel.title: Contracts: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New contracts filings from Korean small and mid caps.

item.title: Ascendio signed a cosmetics supply contract worth KRW 906.4m (906,443,639원), equal to 15.31% of recent revenue, with an overseas distributor.
Kamu E&C won a KRW 29.5bn (294억원) contract for the Gangbuk–Amsa water transmission connection works from the Public Procurement Service.
IPARK Hyundai Development signed a KRW 350.1bn (3,500.87억원) construction contract with affiliate IPARK I&Cons for a Jinju apartment project.
HDC subsidiary IPARK Hyundai Development won a KRW 350.1bn (3,500억원) construction contract for Jinju Dodong Block B apartments from affiliate IPARK I&Cons.
Kumho Engineering & Construction signed a KRW 175.3bn (1,753억원) contract with Seoul Housing & Communities Corporation for the Jangji depot multi-level development construction.
Hancom LifeCare signed a KRW 18.96bn contract with the Defense Acquisition Program Administration for the 10th mass production of K5 gas masks.
Dongbu Corporation signed a KRW 140.2bn contract with Seoul Housing & Communities Corporation for the Jangji Garage Multi-level Development construction.
ROBOTIS signed a KRW 3.98bn (39.78억원) DYNAMIXEL-X supply contract with Pollen Robotics SAS of France, 10.22% of recent revenue.
Deokshin EPC signed a KRW 11.4bn (114.19억원) contract with Samsung C&T for the Pyeongtaek Campus P5 FAB2 construction.
Protec signed a KRW 23.41bn (234.1억원) semiconductor manufacturing equipment supply contract with Samsung Electronics, equal to 10.2% of recent revenue.
Intekplus signed a KRW 14.6bn (145.9억원) contract to supply semiconductor and substrate inspection equipment to takewin International Ltd for China.
Yooshin signed a KRW 63.6bn (636억원) contract for feasibility study and FEED design consulting on five Hanoi urban rail lines in Vietnam.
Seojeon Electric signed a KRW 7.49bn (74.93억원) contract with Hyundai Engineering & Construction for switchgear and distribution panels.
Jeil Technos signed a KRW 11.66bn (116억원) deck construction contract with Samsung C&T for the Pyeongtaek Campus P5 FAB2 project.
Hanul Materials Science signed a KRW 1.91bn contract to supply gadolinium oxide powder to KEPCO Nuclear Fuel, equal to 14.25% of revenue.
IST signed a KRW 1.96bn (19.6억원) contract to sell semiconductor FOUP Cleaner equipment to Amkor Technology Arizona, Inc.
Daehan Shipbuilding won a KRW 249.8bn (2,498억원) order for two 157,000 DWT crude oil carriers from an Oceania shipowner.
Kumho Engineering & Construction won a KRW 372.0bn (3,720억원) order to build Songdo Severance Hospital from Yonsei University Health System.
AP Satellite signed a KRW 14.7bn contract with Star Satellite Communications to develop and supply two ThurayaTwo satellite smartphone models in the UAE.
Mirae Company signed a KRW 4.8bn (48억원) semiconductor manufacturing equipment supply contract with Samsung Electronics, equal to 11.74% of recent revenue.
Hanul Materials Science signed a KRW 3.56bn (35.55억원) contract with KT for the 2026 Public Safety LTE network PTN build-out.
Prestige Biologics signed a commercial drug substance contract manufacturing contract worth KRW 15.5bn (154.95억원), equal to 58.11% of recent revenue.
TES signed a KRW 48.08bn (480.8억원) semiconductor manufacturing equipment supply contract with SK hynix, 13.69% of recent revenue.
Kumho Engineering & Construction won a KRW 327.9bn order to relocate the Animal Genetic Resources Division, equal to 16.25% of revenue.
Dongbu Corporation signed a KRW 164.0bn (1,639억원) contract for the Livestock Resources Development Division relocation project, 9.32% of revenue.
Hoosung signed a chemical products supply contract worth KRW 71.19bn (711.949억원), equal to 15.10% of recent revenue, with an overseas global chemical company.
Dongwon Development signed a KRW 35.07bn (350억7,300만원) contract with Busan Metropolitan City Construction Headquarters for the BEXCO Exhibition Hall 3 project.
Bridgetec signed a KRW 5.26bn (52.59억원) contract with KT to rebuild BC Card's call center consultation system.
GMB Korea signed a KRW 230.5bn (2,304.9억원) hybrid vehicle parts supply contract with Hyundai Transys, equal to 29.3% of recent revenue.
Gyeryong Construction Industrial won a KRW 83.8bn (837억원) order for the BEXCO Third Exhibition Hall construction project in Busan.
KC Tech signed a KRW 21.1bn (211억원) semiconductor manufacturing equipment supply contract with SK hynix, equal to 5.52% of recent revenue.
HJ Heavy Industries won a KRW 95.5bn (954억원) order for the BEXCO Exhibition Hall 3 construction project, 4.78% of recent revenue.
HD Hyundai Marine Engine signed a KRW 36.1bn (361억원) marine engine supply contract with Samsung Heavy Industries, equal to 9.0% of revenue.
Dasco signed a KRW 32.4bn (323억원) service contract to manage and operate the Sin Dasan Energy solar power project.
Incon signed a KRW 5.46bn (54.6억원) LTE-R upgrade works contract with Korea Rail Network Authority, equal to 10.74% of revenue.
Kyeryong Construction Industrial won a KRW 97.6bn (976억원) order for the Southwest Comprehensive Sports Town sports facility construction in Daejeon.
AK Holdings subsidiary AKIS signed a KRW 3.42bn (3,419,728,000원) AIRBRS upgrade contract with Incheon International Airport Corporation.
KGA signed a KRW 2.8bn (28억원) logistics automation equipment supply contract, equal to 15.45% of recent revenue, with delivery through July 31, 2027.
FADU signed a KRW 20.4bn (203.8억원) enterprise SSD controller supply contract with an overseas NAND flash maker, 22.05% of revenue.
